question:
A voltage-divider biased NPN transistor has $V_{CC}=12\,\text{V}$, $R_1=60\,\text{k}\Omega$ (from $V_{CC}$ to base), $R_2=20\,\text{k}\Omega$ (from base to ground), $R_C=2.0\,\text{k}\Omega$, and $R_E=1.0\,\text{k}\Omega$.

Assume $\beta=100$ and $V_{BE}=0.7\,\text{V}$.

Using Thevenin equivalent of the base divider, estimate the collector current $I_C$ and $V_{CE}$.
